description: Source code for the Http2PushPromiseIndex class, managing HTTP/2 push promise streams within the net namespace, including registration, unregistration, lookup, and claiming of push streams.

classes.name: Http2PushPromiseIndex
classes.description: Manages unclaimed HTTP/2 push promise streams, allowing registration, lookup, and claiming of streams.

classes.name: CompareByUrl
classes.description: Comparator class for ordering UnclaimedPushedStream objects by URL, delegate, and stream ID.

methods.name: ~Http2PushPromiseIndex
methods.description: Destructor, checks that unclaimed streams are empty.

methods.name: RegisterUnclaimedPushedStream
methods.description: Registers a new unclaimed pushed stream with a URL, stream ID, and delegate.

methods.name: UnregisterUnclaimedPushedStream
methods.description: Unregisters a specific unclaimed pushed stream based on URL, stream ID, and delegate.

methods.name: CountStreamsForSession
methods.description: Counts the number of unclaimed streams for a given delegate.

methods.name: FindStream
methods.description: Finds the stream ID associated with a URL and delegate.

methods.name: ClaimPushedStream
methods.description: Claims a pushed stream matching a URL and request info, returning the session and stream ID.
